prompt:
Design an expressive iOS/macOS Air Quality widget for a desktop dashboard. Generate 5 distinct compositions in Small (160x160), Medium (340x160) and Large (340x340). One layout per size, rendered once. Never repeat a row or value.

Compositions (distinct surfaces, palettes & motion):
1 Segmented Spectrum: White (#FFFFFF) card with grey header, thick horizontal bar with multi-colour segments (blue, green, purple, amber) + shimmer, 2x2 dot legend, and huge "32 AQI" bottom hero.
2 Vertical Pill Gauges: White card with bold city header above 3 vertical rounded pill columns filled in green (#34C759), yellow (#FFCC00), and coral (#FF3B30) with white base icons.
3 Bordered Trend: White card with pulsing green wave icon top-right, huge "42 AQI" hero + note, and a bordered graph box at bottom with blue/grey hourly bars.
4 Neon Ring Dark: Pitch black (#111111) card with drifting mist, neon-green circular purity ring top-left, white category header, and huge bottom AQI.
5 Dot-Matrix Teal: Teal (#178582) card with top 3x10 dot-matrix purity grid (pulsing white/yellow lit dots vs dim), white city header, and huge AQI hero.

Hard content limits per size:
Small: AQI hero number, category, city, plus ONE visual (ring, dot-grid, or mini bar). Max 4 items. No pollutants or chart.
Medium: Small's content plus ONE block: 3 vertical pill gauges, 2x2 dot legend + bar, or bordered hourly bar chart.
Large: Medium's content plus ONE more block: 4-pollutant breakdown + 12h trend bars and health note.
Never squeeze larger content into a smaller size.

Spacing & Visual: 24px squircle; padding 16px Small, 20px Medium/Large; 8px grid, 12px+ group gaps, no clipping. One clear hero per size, other text 11-14px (never <11px). Believable data.
designSpec: Five design families each contain one Small, Medium and Large preview, stacked vertically with exact footprints, 24px corners and unique hero readings. Small tiles retain four essential items; larger sizes progressively introduce their visual block, pollutant details, a single 12-hour trend and a health note. Static highlights, halos, mist strokes and luminous dots suggest motion without unsupported animation.
